title: CanonicalJob
description: Unified job posting model — every source normalizes to this before storage.

external_id.description: Job ID as issued by the source ATS — used with source for deduplication

company.description: Company display name, taken from spec schema.json company list

company_slug.description: URL-safe company identifier used in ATS API calls

location.description: Raw location string from the source — not normalized

description_html.description: Full job description as HTML — may be null if source doesn't provide it

source_url.description: Direct link to the job posting on the source site

is_qc.description: True when location matches a Quebec city or region

seniority.description: Derived from title keywords — null when no signal

tech_stack.description: Tech keywords matched in title and description — all matches collected, not first-match

employment_type.description: Derived from title keywords — null when unknown

posted_at.description: When the job was posted — sourced from ATS updated_at or created_at; null if unavailable

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp of the fetch run that produced this record

first_seen_at.description: UTC timestamp of the first fetch where this (source, external_id) appeared — set on insert, never updated

last_seen_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent fetch where this job appeared — used to detect stale/closed postings

is_active.description: Flipped to false when the job stops appearing in the source feed
